integrity: The finite optimum and census are reproduced from the channel definition by exhaustive compatibility-graph construction and complete maximal-clique enumeration. Every extremizer and declared symmetry is rechecked directly. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to binary length \(6\) and the at-most-one-transposition followed by at-most-one-deletion channel. It does not classify longer lengths, nonbinary alphabets, or the full graph-automorphism equivalence relation. A residual originality risk remains from obscure or unindexed finite enumerations.
title: Exact binary length-six one-deletion/one-adjacent-transposition code census
